# 42_chat — Framework SDD Autônomo

> Framework SDD autônomo com agentes IA e humanos in loop. Pipeline: brainstorm → spec → plan → tasks (DAG) → orchestrator → subagentes.

## Navegação do Repositório

- `.github/memory/constitution.md`: Princípios invioláveis do framework (portões de qualidade, restrições, anti-padrões).
- `.github/memory/tech.md`: Stack tecnológica homologada (Hermes Agent, Python, YAML, Markdown, Obsidian).
- `AGENTS.md`: Instruções para agentes de IA que interagem com o repo.
- `TUTORIAL.md`: Guia rápido de 6 passos para começar com o framework.
- `specs/BACKLOG.md`: Backlog de features com status (concluídas, pendentes, pipeline).

## Especificações (Spec-Driven Development)

- `specs/features/001-start-repo/` — Estrutura base do repositório [spec](specs/features/001-start-repo/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/001-start-repo/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/001-start-repo/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/002-sdd-templates/` — Templates canônicos SDD (spec/plan/tasks) [spec](specs/features/002-sdd-templates/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/002-sdd-templates/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/002-sdd-templates/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/003-forge-skill/` — Scaffold de skills Hermes [spec](specs/features/003-forge-skill/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/003-forge-skill/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/003-forge-skill/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/004-sdd-tasks-dag/` — Tasks com DAG (dependências, paralelismo, isolamento) [spec](specs/features/004-sdd-tasks-dag/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/004-sdd-tasks-dag/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/004-sdd-tasks-dag/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/005-runtime-orchestrator/` — Runtime orchestrator (spawna subagentes em paralelo) [spec](specs/features/005-runtime-orchestrator/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/005-runtime-orchestrator/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/005-runtime-orchestrator/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/006-agent-dev/` — Agente implementador (persona fixa, skills plugáveis) [spec](specs/features/006-agent-dev/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/006-agent-dev/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/006-agent-dev/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/100-42chat-core/` — **Feature 100: 42 Chat Core** — Chat multiplayer com frontend React+Vite, backend Go, WebSocket, autenticação 42 API, matchmaking P2P, BDD (Gherkin + Playwright) ✅ implementado [spec](specs/features/100-42chat-core/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/100-42chat-core/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/100-42chat-core/tasks.md)
- `specs/features/101-assinatura-participacao/` — **Feature 101: Assinatura de Participação** — Componente UserSignature inline com stats de engajamento, tiers (novato→veterano), API on-demand + WebSocket push ✅ implementado [spec](specs/features/101-assinatura-participacao/spec.md) [plan](specs/features/101-assinatura-participacao/plan.md) [tasks](specs/features/101-assinatura-participacao/tasks.md)

## Agentes Hermes

Agentes definidos em `.hermes/agents/`, versionados no repo:

- `onboard` — Inicializa projeto no framework SDD (init repo, explore tech, brainstorm features).
- `agent-orchestrator` — Executor runtime. Lê `tasks.md` com DAG e spawna subagentes em paralelo via `delegate_task`.
- `agent-dev` — Persona implementadora. Ciclo: lê contexto → planeja → implementa → smoke-test → reporta (DONE/FAIL/BLOCKED).
